SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, MIN(calendar_date) s, MAX(calendar_date) e, COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_week) wks, MIN(fiscal_week) w1, MAX(fiscal_week) w2
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

WITH w AS (
 SELECT f.*, o.status, o.login_state, o.member_key AS o_member_key,
  CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 WHERE s.store_id=900 AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-03-22')
SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) dist_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_id,
 SUM(CASE WHEN member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_mem,
 SUM(CASE WHEN login_state='guest' AND member_key IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) guest_with_mem,
 SUM(CASE WHEN login_state='logged_in' AND member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) li_nomem,
 SUM(CASE WHEN member_key IS DISTINCT FROM o_member_key THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch,
 SUM(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff, COUNT(DISTINCT status) st, MIN(etl_loaded_at), MAX(etl_loaded_at)
FROM w

WITH w AS (
 SELECT f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.member_key lm, f.net_amount, o.login_state, o.member_key om, f.etl_loaded_at,
  CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 WHERE s.store_id=900)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN login_state='logged_in' AND lm IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) li_null_line,
 SUM(CASE WHEN login_state='logged_in' AND lm IS NULL THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) li_null_net,
 SUM(CASE WHEN login_state='logged_in' AND lm IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) li_ok,
 SUM(CASE WHEN login_state='guest' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) guest, SUM(CASE WHEN lm IS NULL AND om IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) om_not_lm
FROM w JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=w.dd
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 12 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT MIN(f.sale_date), MAX(f.sale_date), MIN(f.etl_loaded_at), MAX(f.etl_loaded_at), COUNT(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) ld, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) orders,
 SUM(CASE WHEN m.member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) om_unmatched
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=o.member_key
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.login_state='logged_in' AND f.member_key IS NULL

SELECT d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week, SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NULL AND o.login_state='logged_in' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_li, COUNT(*) n, MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) mn, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 38 AND 48 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

WITH web_lines AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, f.net_amount, f.member_key AS line_member, o.member_key AS order_member, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected')
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
)
SELECT fiscal_period,
  SUM(net_amount) all_net,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) test_net,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category<>'ZZ Test' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) net_clean,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category<>'ZZ Test' AND line_member IS NOT NULL THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) member_line_raw,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category<>'ZZ Test' AND order_member IS NOT NULL THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) member_fixed,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category<>'ZZ Test' AND (order_member IS NOT NULL) <> (line_member IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mism
FROM web_lines GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_lines AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, f.net_amount, o.member_key AS order_member
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected')
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
), ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) ctl_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_period,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_member IS NOT NULL THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(net_amount), 2) AS member_share_of_web_sales_pct,
  SUM(net_amount) web_net, MAX(c.ctl_net) ctl
FROM web_lines w JOIN ctl c ON c.fiscal_period=w.fiscal_period GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2
